name: Belize

registry.name: Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (BCCAR)

support.name: BELTRAIDE (Belize Trade and Investment Development Service)

activities.label: Selling goods or running a general business
activities.plain: A shop, a restaurant, a workshop, farming for sale, transport and similar.

activities.label: Offering a professional service
activities.plain: For example an accountant, a lawyer, a consultant, an architect or a doctor.

activities.label: Renting out property or equipment
activities.plain: Rent received from houses, rooms or equipment.

legalStatuses.label: Self-employed or sole trader
legalStatuses.plain: You run the business as an individual, under your own name or a business name. You and the business are the same person. Usually the simplest way to start.
legalStatuses.feeNote: You need a trade licence from your local authority. Your town or city council gives you the current fees.

legalStatuses.label: Limited company
legalStatuses.plain: The company is its own legal person, separate from you. It costs more to set up and has more paperwork, but it can limit your personal risk.
legalStatuses.feeNote: A company costs more to set up than a business name. The registry will quote you the current fees.

launchSteps.label: Register your business or company
launchSteps.plain: A company is incorporated with the Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (BCCAR). A sole trader registers the business name if it is not the owner's own name.

launchSteps.label: Get your trade licence
launchSteps.plain: You get it from your local authority (town or city council) before you start trading.

launchSteps.label: Register with the Belize Tax Service for business tax
launchSteps.plain: Business tax is paid every month, on your total receipts.

launchSteps.label: Register with the Social Security Board
launchSteps.plain: Self-employed people can register and pay 7% of their declared weekly income.

launchSteps.label: Open a separate bank account for the business
launchSteps.plain: Keeping business money apart from household money makes your numbers clearer and your taxes easier to pay.

launchSteps.label: Register as an employer with the Belize Tax Service and the Social Security Board
launchSteps.plain: With employees you pay income tax withheld and Social Security each month, by the 14th of the following month.

launchSteps.label: Register for GST
launchSteps.plain: Required when your sales or receipts reach BZ$75,000 a year. Register with the GST Department.

contributions.label: Social Security
contributions.plain: Social Security gives access to a pension and other benefits. Self-employed people pay 7% of their declared weekly income, up to BZ$320 a week.

vat.label: General Sales Tax
vat.filingNote: Your filing period is set when you register.

calendar.monthlyText: Pay business tax on your total receipts for the month. The Belize Tax Service gives you the payment date when you register.
calendar.annualTextPersonal: File your annual tax return. The Belize Tax Service gives you the form and the date.
calendar.payrollText: Every month: pay Social Security and income tax withheld for the previous month.
calendar.vatText: If you are registered for GST: file your return for each period. Your period is set when you register.

notes: Business tax in Belize is charged on your total receipts (sales), not on your profit. No costs are deducted. It applies once your yearly sales pass BZ$75,000 (BZ$20,000 for professional services).
toVerify: Social Security banded rates and weekly ceiling for employees and employers (the 7% rate and the BZ$55 to BZ$320 weekly range for the self-employed are confirmed by the Social Security Board)
